sources.quote: Correct, the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.
Status: rejected on 2026-10-02 by A. Conti

findings.why: The re-audit only restored Chisone's company standing. The approved supplier list covers BR-220 at Beinasco for Aurelia only for Bormida (SUP-B). It has no approval for Chisone (SUP-C), and the temporary-source deviation was rejected. Quality approving the company last week does not approve the part.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only. BR-220 is drawn in 6082-T6, yield at least 250.
they can make BR-220 blanks from the same alloy they use for BR-310, so it should be a formality

findings.why: The BR-220 drawing requires 6082-T6. Chisone is qualified only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5, and the claim of the same alloy as BR-310 is a phone statement with no evidence. Nothing shows 6082-T6 capability against the yield of at least 250.

findings.key: 8D on Chisone 6082 cracks (no issue id given)

sources.quote: The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet, corrective action still being verified.
the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open

findings.why: Chisone has an open 8D on 6082 material, and BR-220 is a 6082 part. It is still open as of 2026-11-06. The 8D id is not given in the documents.
